name: Scree Hollow

abilities.name: Engulf (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The hollow engulfs one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While engulfed, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the hollow, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hollow's turns. The hollow can have only one creature engulfed at a time. If the hollow takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the engulfed creature, the hollow must expel the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the hollow. If the hollow dies, an engulfed creature pulls free of the mass prone by using 5 feet of movement.

abilities.name: Burying Bulwark (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: One creature within 5 feet that hit the hollow with an attack roll since the end of the hollow's last turn takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hollow makes two Avalanche Wrap attacks.

actions.name: Avalanche Wrap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.
